pick.headline: Russian forces enter Chechnya
pick.summary: On December 11, 1994, Russian troops moved into Chechnya to crush its declared independence.
pick.significance: The war became a disaster for the Russian army and Boris Yeltsin.
pick.fbis: The Central Eurasia report of December 12, 1994, carried Federation Council speaker Shumeyko saying troops had been sent to Chechnya to form 'isolation circles' around Groznyy, and ITAR-TASS on Ingushetia's president opposing armor crossing his republic, where four Ingush were killed on Sunday.

evidence.title: FBIS Daily Report: Central Eurasia, No. 238, 12 December 1994
evidence.snippet: …Text] Groznyy, 12 Dec—A telephone conversation took place on Sunday evening between Dzhokhar Dudayev and Ruslan Aushev, president of Ingushetia, the ITAR-TASS correspondent has learned from well-informed sources in the Chechen president’s entourage.
